Attached: 1 image

Ninja now opens above any app, like Spotlight or Alfred. In the PrivacyNotes desktop apps, press Option+Shift+Space (Alt+Shift+Space on Windows and Linux) to find a note, type "+Dentist fri 3pm", or write a quick note with Cmd+N. Quick notes work offline and even while the app is locked: they wait encrypted until you unlock. No AI, nothing sent to a server to be understood. Free.

https://privacynotes.app/#downloads
